_comment: beyond-ui run config. Copy to <project>/.beyond-ui/config.json and edit. Resolution order for every key: process env > project .beyond-ui/config.json > this file.

teardown._targetSites_note: FIVE references, not 10 — the condensed-skill rule. scripts/skills-router.mjs verify fails a run that selected more.

browserUse._note: Human-like QA layer: surf the built app like a person (click, type, scroll, judge) and record the journey. scripts/qa.mjs journey runs the same checks through Playwright when browser-use is absent, so the QA gate is never silently skipped.
browserUse._python_note: Absolute path to the interpreter that has browser-use installed. Empty = try python/python3/py. BEYOND_UI_PYTHON env overrides this.
browserUse._autoInstall_note: true = `pip install -U browser-use` during the tool-layer install when absent. Set false to only report.

mcp._server_note: Run `uvx browser-use --mcp` (or `python -m browser_use.mcp`) and register it as an MCP server in your agent to drive the browser directly. Optional: qa.mjs covers the same journey without it.

browserUse._journeys_note: Journeys scripts/qa.mjs journey walks by default; edit per project.

scrapling._note: The keyless acquisition engine. No API key, no account, no LLM, no quota — it replaces firecrawl AND browser-use. PREFERRED path is the Scrapling-Plugin MCP server (agent calls the tools directly, no shell). CLI fallback resolution: `scrapling` on PATH -> <python> -m scrapling.cli -> docker pyd4vinci/scrapling (only with --docker).

mcp._note: Scrapling-Plugin (github.com/Jeetaksh25/Scrapling-Plugin) — installs 13 MCP tools + the scrapling skill + the /scrape command into every detected agent. Run `npx -y github:Jeetaksh25/Scrapling-Plugin`.
mcp._prefer_note: true = when the MCP server is registered, the agent calls the tools (make_request -> fetch -> stealthy_fetch) and scripts/scrapling.mjs is only the fallback. false = always go through the CLI bridge.
mcp._autoInstall_note: true = `npx -y github:Jeetaksh25/Scrapling-Plugin` during bootstrap when the server is not already registered. Set false to only report.
mcp._server_note: MCP server name as it appears in the agent's MCP tool list; tools are exposed as mcp__scrapling__<tool>.

scrapling._python_note: Absolute path to the interpreter that has scrapling installed. Empty = try python/python3/py. BEYOND_UI_PYTHON env overrides this.
scrapling._autoInstall_note: true = `pip install "scrapling[all]>=0.4.15"` when no engine resolves. Set false to only report.
scrapling._installBrowser_note: true = run `scrapling install --force` so fetch/stealthy-fetch/screenshot work. `get` needs no browser.
scrapling._escalation_note: Tier order per URL. `get` is impersonated plain HTTP; `fetch` renders JS; `stealthy-fetch` adds stealth and solves Cloudflare. Escalation costs stealth, never speed.
scrapling._pagesPerSite_note: Same-origin pages pulled per reference as markdown (real copy structure).
scrapling._proxy_note: Optional. Forwarded to scraping via --proxy / SCRAPLING proxy args. Never ship a proxy you are not licensed to use.

plan._note: Upper bound on sections the deterministic planner may select from assets/block-catalog.json.

mobileApp.name: pageflows
mobileApp.signal: recorded real-user flows; listing free, content paywalled

mobileApp.name: refero
mobileApp.signal: web + iOS screenshots; JS-rendered — Playwright capture

galleries._fetch_note: Fetch every gallery through scripts/scrapling.mjs. It escalates get -> fetch -> stealthy-fetch automatically and handles the 429/JS-only cases above without a key.
